name: PI Industries
title: Transcript of the Earnings Conference Call pertaining to the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026

read.thesis: Q2 revenue Rs 1,702 crore down 9% YoY with AgChem exports down 18% (about 13-14% price, 3-4% volume); management says capacity is saturated for 2-3 years and no FY27 guidance was re-stated beyond "flattish".

capex.quote: I believe the investments have come to a saturation capacity to take care for the next 2-3 years in the ag chem sector.

triggers.label: AgChem capacity saturated 2-3 yrs
triggers.quote: the investments have come to a saturation capacity to take care for the next 2-3 years in the ag chem sector

triggers.label: AgChem exports price down ~13-14%
triggers.quote: Volume is about a lower single digit, about 3% to 4% , the other is being price and cost.

triggers.label: Gross margin 47-48% now, 49% target
triggers.quote: The gross margin as we said is about today at 47%-48%.

triggers.label: FY27 growth now 'flattish' vs LSD
triggers.quote: we have said we look at a flattish approach given the external dynamics

triggers.label: NWC cut 18 days; Rs 298 cr released
triggers.quote: we reduce net working capital by 18 days, releasing Rs. 298 crores of cash as at quarter end

guidance.quote: keeping that and trying to improve that should be our objective in the next 2-3 quarters
we are currently around Rs. 700 odd crore, and we expect to be in the same range.

guidance.value: Rs 500-600 crore revenue and EBITDA breakeven in 2-3 years
guidance.quote: Yes, that is our target. We still continue to work on that.

guidance.value: USD 10+ million loss for full year
guidance.quote: It is about $10 plus million that we have lost there.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we have said we look at a flattish approach given the external dynamics
we continue to invest 3% to 4% of our revenue in R &D, which are fully charged to the P&L

red_flags.label: Price cuts spread to patented molecules
red_flags.quote: is the price pressure is becoming challenging for our partners

red_flags.label: Management avoids pricing and margin floor questions
red_flags.quote: It would be too much of competitive information to disclose.

red_flags.label: Gross margin falling; no price pass-through
red_flags.quote: cost escalation could not be passed through in this current market conditions

evasions.topic: Market share and global pricing floor
evasions.quote: It would be too much of competitive information to disclose.
we will be taking up to get a better assessment as to how we want to scale
I would not hold myself to that number
